lore:
### The Folded Path: An Entry on the *Gate* Spell

The spell *Gate* represents the ultimate defiance of distance. Visually, it manifests as a vertical aperture of swirling, opalescent light—a jagged wound in the tapestry of our world. To gaze through is to see the impossible: the golden spires of Celestia or the churning mists of the Abyss, framed by a rim of crackling, violet sparks that hiss with the sound of rushing wind.

Shaping the Weave for such a feat is a harrowing ordeal. The practitioner feels the cosmic threads tighten to the breaking point, vibrating with a low, bone-deep thrum. It is as if one is gripping the very fabric of existence and rending it asunder; a sudden, chilling void-pressure rushes forth as two disparate planes are forcibly sutured together.

Chronicles attribute its discovery to the **Star-Seer Elara**. Seeking a path to the progenitor suns, she sang a note so resonant it pierced the firmament. She vanished into the rift, leaving behind only a scorched circle and the secret of the Folded Path.
